title: E-Sessionary App (2026)
description: In the past months, E-Sessionary focused primarily on its main system for managing legislative sessions and records. With this new update, E-Sessionary now introduces a dedicated application for authorized legislative officials, allowing them to conveniently view both current and past Sangguniang Bayan sessions. This enhancement expands the system's capabilities by providing officials with easier access to session information and historical legislative records, promoting more accessible, organized, and efficient legislative operations.

title: E-Sessionary (2026)
description: A standalone desktop application developed for the Sangguniang Bayan of Talisay, Local Government Unit of Talisay, Camarines Norte. It digitizes legislative session workflows, document handling, and records management.

title: DogGo (2025)
description: Veterinary Clinic Management System that combines clinic management, an IoT-enabled dog collar, GPS tracking, heart-rate monitoring, and QR-based dog identification.

title: Farm Villa (2022)
description: A website project for booking a relaxing farm getaway. It allows users to explore the property, check its amenities and availability, and reserve dates for their stay.

title: Until Sunrise 2025)
description: A survival game concept centered on surviving dangerous nighttime challenges while exploring your surroundings, managing resources, and completing objectives before sunrise.

title: E-Laura (2022)
description: An educational quiz game based on the famous Filipino literary work Florante at Laura.
